claims: UFC Fight Night in Seattle featured Joe Pyfer defeating Israel Adesanya via TKO in the second round on March 28, 2026.
Alexa Grasso defeated Maycee Barber by first-round submission in the co-main event.
Joe Pyfer defeated Israel Adesanya by TKO (strikes) at 4:18 of Round 2.
Joe Pyfer vs Israel Adesanya was the main event of UFC Seattle on March 28, 2026.
Alexa Grasso defeated Maycee Barber by submission (rear-naked choke) in Round 1.
Alexa Grasso vs Maycee Barber was the co-main event.
Michael Chiesa defeated Niko Price by submission (rear-naked choke).
Michael Chiesa vs Niko Price was a welterweight bout.
Terrance McKinney defeated Kyle Nelson by TKO in Round 1.
Terrance McKinney vs Kyle Nelson was a lightweight bout.
Moicano vs. Duncan is on April 4, 2026, 5:00 PM PDT in Las Vegas.
Prochazka vs. Ulberg is on April 11, 2026, 6:00 PM PDT in Miami.
Burns vs. Malott is on April 18, 2026, 5:00 PM PDT in Winnipeg.
All events are available on Paramount+.
